message.content: On August 6, 2026, Turalyon announced several new components for the garden project. Firstly, he mentioned that the team planned to limit noisy activities from 2-3 pm. Additionally, he suggested putting up temporary barriers or using quieter tools during that timeframe, highlighting the importance of noise management. Furthermore, Turalyon proposed informing residents a day in advance about particularly loud work, suggesting that this could help them plan around the disruptions. Another suggestion was to use a notice board or chat updates to keep everyone informed about ongoing projects. These measures indicate a concerted effort to minimize disturbances and ensure that residents can enjoy the garden despite construction activities.
